# Oral-B UK

> Oral-B UK provides electric and manual toothbrushes, whitening toothpastes, and comprehensive oral health guidance for families and professionals.

Oral-B is a leading oral care brand offering a range of toothbrushes, dental care products, and educational resources. The site features product catalogs, troubleshooting support, and health initiatives focused on inclusive dental care and children's oral hygiene.

## Key Topics

- Electric toothbrush
- Kids toothbrush
- Whitening toothpaste
- Oral health
- Connectivity issues
- Product support
- Children's dental care
- Plaque removal
- Gum health
- Manual toothbrush
- Stannous fluoride
- Oral-B Professional
- Accessibility and inclusive care
- Dental hygiene
- Customer support

## Customer Support & Troubleshooting

- [Support Hub](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/contact-us): Oral-B customer service and support contact hub
- [Issues with connectivity](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/connectivity-issues): Troubleshooting tips for Oral-B toothbrush app connectivity problems
- [Toothbrush position detection not working](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/connectivity-issues/position-detection-not-working): Troubleshooting guide for Oral-B app position detection feature issues
- [Damaged cable, plug or adapter](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/issues-with-accessories/damaged-cable-plug-adapter): Support guide for damaged Oral-B toothbrush cables and adapters
- [My toothbrush is moldy or has a moldy smell](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/other-issues/my-toothbrush-is-moldy-or-has-a-moldy-smell): Troubleshooting and cleaning guide for moldy Oral-B toothbrushes
